title: Emergency preparedness
learning_outcomes: Explain local hazards and alerts in the context of emergency preparedness.
Compare and distinguish supplies and communication in the context of emergency preparedness.
Apply evacuation and shelter in the context of emergency preparedness.
Evaluate and justify decisions about accessibility in the context of emergency preparedness.

lessons.title: Local hazards and alerts
lessons.outcome: Explain local hazards and alerts in the context of emergency preparedness.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving local hazards and alerts; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to household emergency plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain local hazards and alerts from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of local hazards and alerts; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Supplies and communication
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish supplies and communication in the context of emergency preparedness.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving supplies and communication; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to household emergency plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain supplies and communication from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of supplies and communication; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Evacuation and shelter
lessons.outcome: Apply evacuation and shelter in the context of emergency preparedness.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving evacuation and shelter; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to household emergency plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain evacuation and shelter from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of evacuation and shelter; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Accessibility
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about accessibility in the context of emergency preparedness.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving accessibility; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to household emergency plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain accessibility from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of accessibility; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of local hazards and alerts; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of supplies and communication; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of evacuation and shelter; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of accessibility; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
